body: Audit docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md, feasibility: B-8 crossfade does not exist (two documents wrongly say it does); it needs a second player and an engine change, so it is Large with real risk. Android Auto browse and voice search are already built (encore_audio_handler.dart); the home-screen widget has no code. The word 'Data saver' already names a quality level (domain/audio_quality.dart).
